description: Conflict, correction and retraction scenarios for repeated real-model runs. Delivery is asserted deterministically; model behaviour is judged by positive rules where possible.

cases.title: Two conflicting values must both be surfaced
cases.claims: Both conflicting records are delivered, and the reply must mention both values; picking one silently fails.

realModel.note: Both values must appear; the rule cannot tell whether the reply called them a conflict.

cases.title: A correction replaces the old value
cases.claims: After an explicit correction the new value is delivered and the old value is absent; the reply must use the new value.

realModel.note: The corrected value must appear and the replaced value must not be presented as current.

cases.title: A retracted fact is not delivered
cases.claims: A retracted record is not delivered at all; a reply that repeats it fails.

realModel.note: Absence-only rule: satisfying it is reported as uncertain, never pass.
